name: World Chess PLC
summary: Operating through its various subsidiaries, World Chess PLC specializes in the global commercialization of chess-related ventures. Its diverse portfolio includes organizing competitive tournaments, managing the official online gaming platform for the International Chess Federation (FIDE) and other sports, cultivating lifestyle and social initiatives centered on the game, and offering a range of chess-themed merchandise. The company was founded in 2012 and maintains its headquarters in London, United Kingdom.
